item.description:
0.5.0

Everything a console cable needs, and the terminal stops losing what you paste.

  • Paste is paced. A switch at 9600 with no flow control drops what it cannot buffer — silently. Settings ▸ Paste delay fixes that, and the bytes themselves are untouched.
  • Snippets. The commands you type all day, on ⌃⌘1…⌃⌘9.
  • File transfer over serial — XMODEM, XMODEM-1K, YMODEM and ZMODEM, with drag and drop.
  • Adapters say what they are, and unplugging one is noticed instead of leaving a dead session looking live.
  • The version is on screen and says whether it is the latest.
  • Downloads resume, and an upload that dies part-way no longer leaves a file that looks complete.
